WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land known as Tax Lot 1 on Block 2135 on the Tax Map of Brooklyn, New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit “A", annexed hereto (said land, “Owner's Land"), and WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of certain land known as Tax Lot 35 on Block 2135 on the Tax Map of Brooklyn, New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit "B" annexed hereto (said land, the “Developer's Land")(Owner's Land and Developer's Land, collectively, the “Property"), and WHEREAS, Owner intends to demolish any and all improvements now existing on Owner's Land and to construct new buildings and improvements on all or a portion of Owner's Land (such new buildings and any replacements thereof or additions thereto, “Owner's Buildings"); and WHEREAS, Developer intends to demolish any and all improvements now existing on Developer's Land and to construct new buildings and improvements on all or a kent-Development Agmt(3).doc

portion of Developer's Land (such new buildings and any replacements thereof or additions thereto, “Developer's Buildings"); and WHEREAS, the Property is subject to a Declaration executed by Owner and Wythe Gardens LLC dated June 21, 2002 and recorded at Reel 5700 Page 1440 and amended by Amendment of Declaration dated as of November 14, 2002 and recorded at Reel 5901, Page 2322, (as amended, “"the Declaration"); and WHEREAS, the Property is required to be developed in accordance with the conditions, restrictions and limitations set forth in the Declaration including, without limitation, in accordance with the plan attached thereto as Exhibit "D" (the “"Declaration Plans"); and WHEREAS, the Declaration further requires that former South 9"h Street and former South 1o"h Street between Kent and Wythe Avenues (such streets, the “Private Streets") be constructed and maintained in accordance with the conditions, restrictions and limitations set forth in the Declaration; and WHEREAS, the parties have agreed between themselves, within the parameters set forth in the Declaration and on the Declaration Plans, (i) to allocate the number of dwelling units to be constructed on each of the Owner's Land and the Developer's Land, respectively, (ii) the location of parking spaces to be provided for Owner's Buildings and Developer's Buildings, respectively, and (i) the maximum number of square feet of floor area to be incorporated in the Owner's Buildings and Developer's Buildings, respectively; and WHEREAS, Owner's Land and Developer's Land comprise a single zoning lot (the “Zoning Lot"); and WHEREAS, Owner and Developer are simultaneously herewith executing and delivering a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") as defined in Section 12- kent-Development Agmt(3).doc 司
